steps.note: Open the events list to reach the saved draft.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition lock configuration.
Verify the events list rendered successfully.
Switch to the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Open the first saved draft, which reopens its create screen.
Click the arrows-alt control and record what it opens or changes without confirming any dialog.
Verify the expected vendor list includes A & A ENTERPRISES.
Verify the expected vendor list includes A 2 Z COMPUTER & GRAPHICS.
Verify the expected vendor list includes AAA ENTERPRISES.
Verify the expected vendor list includes AARKAY ENTERPRISES.
Verify the list indicates eight additional vendors.
